action.command:
cd /workspace && for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/live.json -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "LIVE OK after ~$((i*5))s (http $code)"; break; fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "=== /health/live body ==="; cat /tmp/live.json 2>/dev/null; echo
